caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular segment of woven fabric that features a repeating geometric pattern. The pattern consists of small rectangular and square shapes arranged in a grid-like manner, with some shapes forming rings or loops and some appearing solid. The color palette is limited to shades of blue and off-white, with the blue portions concentrated in the rectangular and square forms, while the off-white portions fill the spaces in between, outlining the grid structure. The weaving is uneven in its density, creating areas where the blue is more concentrated and others where the off-white predominates. The edges of the fabric are bordered by a thin off-white margin, and the entire image sits upon an off-white background. At the bottom left corner of the image, there is a visible text that reads "MAGNUS S. FOSSUM".
title: Coverlet
